title: Workload contract, no-spend quote/budget engine and artifact manifests (IMP-0015 slice 3)
summary: Roadmap Phase 0 contracts plus the deterministic part of the quote engine. workload.py normalizes every request (type incl. training/adapter_training, modalities text..audio, capabilities incl. asr/tts/diarization/image_editing/lora, sizes incl. images/audio_seconds/dataset_tokens/epochs, resources, sensitivity, budget, reliability) so image/audio/training need no schema change (acceptance 2, 9). Sensitivity sets a deployment floor (secret -> local; private -> local/gpu_pod/serverless) that explicit requirements can only narrow; to_requirements feeds router.select. quote.py prices options from explicit inputs (API USD/Mtok; GPU USD/hour + throughput + startup/idle/storage) as the expected cost of a verified success (geometric retry factor), with low/expected/high bands, API-vs-GPU saving, and a budget gate: a paid option is allowed only with budget.approved === true AND the high estimate within job_hard_cap_usd (and project_usd); otherwise requires_approval with the reason (acceptance 5, 7). artifacts.py builds content-addressed manifests (base model+revision required for adapters/checkpoints, training-config digest), verifies local checkpoints by sha256/size, and picks the latest resumable checkpoint of a job (acceptance 8, bookkeeping part). `orchestrate quote` exposes it. No network, no provisioning, no model calls. Throughput/price inputs are the operator's or a later live-pricing adapter's; the engine does not invent prices.
